rows.en: Well, as long as you're okay.
(...The breeze feels nice.)
Huh, it's Luca-kun.
I see. Same as me, then.
...Hey, Luca-kun.
Let's keep our spirits up, okay?
Well, as long as you're okay...
Yo, Luca. Long time no see.

You look well,
\p-san.
You too, Luca.

Thankfully, my days have been
very fulfilling.

So you spend your rare days off
maintaining 'Samson', huh?

Yes.
If I get too busy and don't give it attention,
it gets in a bad mood, you see.
Is that how it works...?
rows.notes: Shared with frd_yuu_005 (player to Akimizu, answered 'Yes, that's how it is'); works for both.

rows.en: Is something wrong?
rows.notes: Shared with Shirakawa in frd_myk_003 (player staring at her); works for both.

rows.en: N-no, nothing!
You look like you're having fun, Luca.
Yes, very much.
Want me to help?
No, thank you.
Now, now, don't be shy...
Honestly! What if it breaks?!

Uh, could you not talk like
I'm going to break it?

No way!
I won't let you lay a finger on Samson!!
Aw, come on, just a little bit is fine...
It is not fine!
You're so stubborn...
Then I'm happy to be stubborn!

Oh well. Let's wrap this up fast
and go flying!

Luca ending (male).
Slot filler for female.
rows.notes: Developer filler text (name plate Alto), worded like the other ending fillers (c06488).

rows.en:
Luca ending (female).
Slot filler for male.
rows.notes: Developer filler text (name plate Alto), worded like the other ending fillers (c06488).

rows.en: Hey, Luca-kun, long time no see.
You too, Luca-kun.

Spending your rare days off
maintaining 'Samson'?
N-no, nothing at all! Yep!
You look like you're having fun, Luca-kun.
Want me to help out?
Aw, come on, just a little bit...

What's that supposed to mean?
Don't talk like I'm going to break it!
It is not fine!!

Oh, whatever. Let's wrap this up fast
and go flying!

(The hot dogs here are something else.
I could eat any number of them.)

Huh, \p-san...
What are you doing here?

Hey, Luhka...
You here fo' hah-dahgs too?
rows.notes: Player talking with a mouthful: garbled 'Hey, Luca... you here for hot dogs too?'

rows.en:
Honestly... talking with your mouth full
is so unseemly.
Besides, I don't eat hot dogs.

*gulp*...
Aww, but they're so good.
I've only just eaten.
So, what are you doing out here?

Eating my way around town
for a change of pace, I guess?

...If you eat nothing but junk food,
you'll get fat, you know.
It's fine, I'll just exercise it off.
Well, if you say so...
So with that, let's go train, Luca!
H-hey, wait!!

(The hot dogs here are something else.
I could eat any number of them.)

Hey, Luhka-hun...
Luhka-hun, you here fo' hah-dahgs too?
rows.notes: Garbled mouthful; the -kun is garbled to '-hun' as the Japanese garbles it.

rows.en:
Eating my way around town
for a change of pace, of course!
I-I'll exercise it off, so it's fine!
So with that, let's go train, Luca-kun!
(Today I went around having fun with Luca.)
The hot dogs here are delicious.

Right?
I could eat any number of them!
Well, one is plenty for me...

Don't say that.
Try this Chili-Chili Dog too!
rows.notes: chirichiri doggu without 'super': 'Chili-Chili Dog' (glossary has Super Chili-Chili Dog).

rows.en: I don't want it!
S-stop it! Don't put it in my mouth!!
Delicious, right?
It was so good you're speechless, huh?
...I just lost my voice, that's all...
rows.notes: Luca corrects 'speechless' (kotoba ga denai) to 'my voice won't come out' (koe ga denai): the chili.

rows.en: Hahaha, you're so dramatic, Luca.
(Today I went around having fun with Luca-kun.)
It was so good you're speechless, huh?
Ahaha, you're so dramatic, Luca-kun.

uncertain: c09295/c09296: developer filler lines (name plate Alto) translated as filler, in the style of c06488.
c09330: chirichiri doggu without 'super' rendered 'Chili-Chili Dog'.
